producer_report.summary: I moved the status-rendering group out of display.rs into the new display/status_view.rs and re-exported `status` and `snapshot_status`. display.rs now has about 1462 production lines, down from about 1942. The bodies are copied unchanged, and the section helpers became pub(super) so the display tests and `trace` can reach them. I also fixed the athena-core test that broke last time. It now searches status_view.rs as well as display.rs for the printed labels, and the label list and assertions are unchanged. CHANGELOG.md has a Changed entry. The display tests, the athena-core test, the policy scan and the mirrors test all pass. I did not run the full workspace tests, fmt or clippy; those are left to Athena's checks.

checks_run.note: 22 display tests pass; build had no warnings

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs has fewer than 1500 production lines (test module excluded) and the status-rendering functions (plan_suffix, status, snapshot_status, code_health_section, introspection and their section helpers) are defined in the new crates/athena-cli/src/display/status_view.rs, checkable with Grep/Read.
criteria_check.evidence: Grep shows `#[cfg(test)]` at line 1463 of display.rs, so about 1462 production lines. status_view.rs defines plan_suffix, lines_section, trend_section, repeated_causes_section, dormant_causes_section, snapshot_status, status, code_health_section and introspection.

criteria_check.criterion: display.rs re-exports status and snapshot_status so no caller outside display changes; moved function bodies are verbatim (git diff shows only moves plus visibility/import edits).
criteria_check.evidence: display.rs has `pub use status_view::{snapshot_status, status};`. Bodies were copied unchanged. The only edits are pub(super) on the helpers (the tests and trace use them) and the new imports. The shared helpers stayed in display.rs and are reached through `use super::{..}`. cargo test -p athena-cli built with no caller changes.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --workspace`: all tests pass, including athena-core status::mistake_tests::every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line and the athena-cli display tests.

open_issues: The misplaced doc comment above trend_section was carried over as it was, as the request said.
learnings: A child module can call its parent's private functions, so the shared helpers (usd, mistakes, planning_cost_lines and others) did not need widening.
`introspection` is also called by `trace` in display.rs, so display.rs imports it from status_view.
The athena-core test is the only reader of display.rs source text; it now searches both files.
